detailed_description: URL Shortener Preview scans pasted text for URLs that use common shortener domains such as bit.ly, tinyurl.com, t.co, is.gd, lnkd.in, and others listed on the page. Click Analyze URLs to extract matching short links and display them in the results list. The current browser-only tool does not send network requests, follow redirects, retrieve the final destination, inspect HTTP status codes, or verify whether a link is safe. Results can be copied as a simple short-url-to-result list.
usage_steps: Paste text that may contain one or more shortened URLs.
Click Analyze URLs to extract URLs from supported shortener domains.
Review the result list to see which short URLs were detected.
If no supported short URLs are found, read the error message shown in the results area.
Use Copy to copy the displayed results.
usage_examples: Find bit.ly or t.co links inside a copied social media draft.
Check whether a note contains URLs from known shortener services.
Copy a list of detected short links for manual follow-up elsewhere.
Confirm that pasted text does not include any supported shortener domains.
